technical_change: SailPoint CLI 2.5.0 (PR #252, branch feature/DEVREL-3362) ships an updated OAuth authentication flow for the CLI. The official release notes do not elaborate on the specific mechanism changed (grant type, token storage, redirect handling, etc.) - the commit history only labels it 'new oauth flow'.
who_is_affected: Teams that script SailPoint ISC/IdentityIQ automation through the CLI and authenticate it via OAuth.
implementation_impact: Unconfirmed pending release-note detail. Recommend testing the 2.5.0 upgrade against existing CLI-driven pipelines in a non-production tenant before adopting, since OAuth flow changes can silently break scripted auth. Prior CLI releases in the same window (2.4.0 Aug 26, 2.3.0 Aug 20 migrating to golang-sdk v3) show active, fast-moving CLI development this cycle.
material_change_since_last: New finding - no prior scan on record for this console.
